scope: Accept the prepared GitHub profile application and its shared identity contract for the future heyNag.com website. Publication remains a separate verified application step; no website quality or human audience outcome is certified.
implementedChanges: Shortened bio and introduction to remove repeated positioning.
Project entries now name personal contribution and a concrete video-evidence detail, grounded in public source references.
Kept private work as a bounded public sample; no private names, links, screenshots or code included.
Clarified recognition as intention, with actual visitor recognition and recall unmeasured.
Separated UI palette tokens from authoritative character paints and header grounds.
Added future website guardrail against stacking legacy CSS whole-character gestures onto the articulated rig.
Added maintenance and public-evidence records; separately track application receipts.
Kept all mascot geometry, expression, painting and exported images unchanged.

pairRecommendations.brand: Keep Nag visible as the maker. Use the same heyNag name, original moth, warm first-person voice and honest public sample across GitHub and the future website. Accept the tighter current copy; deeper maker decisions can become future evidenced stories.
pairRecommendations.performance: Accept the neutral static welcome in GitHub. Preserve the existing tiny rig; Investigate & share is the future performance contract, not motion demonstrated in this profile. Fine phone gestures are nonessential.
pairRecommendations.identity: Use one universal day avatar, paired existing headers and the shared wordmark. Reuse versioned source for the website; keep native GitHub layout and live text. Do not equate designed resemblance with measured recognition.
pairRecommendations.rigging: Keep the verified current renderer and exported geometry. Reuse source and manifests; website acting belongs to the articulated rig, without stacked legacy CSS gesture/scaling animations.
pairRecommendations.interaction: Keep native links and text, meaningful header alt text and static imagery. Current emulated widths are evidence of fit, not physical-device or screen-reader validation. Website must provide a quiet complete route.
pairRecommendations.audience: Preserve clear Nag attribution, original moth ownership and the three-project public sample. Treat immediate recognition, recall, affection and website effectiveness as unmeasured hypotheses.
pairRecommendations.storyboard: Keep a concise greeting, honest public-work boundary, three destinations and one closing signature. The website expands this into question, contribution, decision and result with real evidence.
pairRecommendations.visual: Keep tiny proportions, complete silhouette, existing palette roles and paired artwork. Accept the universal light avatar on both surrounds and narrow-banner detail limits without an anatomy redraw.
pairRecommendations.sound: Keep GitHub entirely silent and static. Meaning is complete in native text; future sound is optional and cannot be required for understanding or navigation. Quiet repetition is still evaluated through reading rhythm.

limits: These are reviewed local previews; live README and account settings are not yet applied.
The future website is a continuity contract, not a built or tested experience.
Human recognition, recall, emotional attachment and repeat-visit comfort have not been measured.
At the 238px narrow README banner, fine hand and antenna details are small; essential meaning stays in native text.
Browser viewport checks do not establish physical-device behavior, spoken assistive-technology output or every saved GitHub appearance setting.
Public repository inspection supports factual blurbs, not runtime, adoption or professional-outcome claims.
Scores remain individual scoped craft judgments; no unanimous9 claim unless every recorded score actually reaches9.
protocol: Each specialist reads the partner independent review, challenges differences, inspects updated source/evidence, explicitly accepts or objects to the exact pair recommendation and registers their own team vote on this unchanged proposal hash. Any substantive objection prevents full consensus.
